name: Dipterocarp Spinner
subtitle: Helicopter Seed Blower
mechanism: Spins its leaves to blow piercing winged seeds that hit multiple enemies in a lane.

abilities.name: Wind Blow
abilities.effect: Fires a piercing dipterocarp_seed (15 damage) that travels through enemies.

clipAnnotations.attack: Spins violently and expands its mouth to blow the seed.
clipAnnotations.die: Spins out of control and shrinks.
